title: Allah Is the Best of Planners
subtitle: 8:30, and rebuilding the Ummah

content.alt: Allah Is the Best of Planners

content.text: Do things look bleak when you look at the state of the Ummah? Imagine how they looked in the early years in Makkah. A handful of believers, many of them poor or enslaved, boycotted and beaten. Then the leaders of Quraysh met to decide what to do with the Prophet ﷺ himself.

content.alt: وَإِذْ يَمْكُرُ بِكَ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا لِيُثْبِتُوكَ أَوْ يَقْتُلُوكَ أَوْ يُخْرِجُوكَ ۚ وَيَمْكُرُونَ وَيَمْكُرُ اللَّهُ ۖ وَاللَّهُ خَيْرُ الْمَاكِرِينَ (Qur'an 8:30)

content.text: "Remember when the disbelievers plotted against you, to imprison you, or kill you, or drive you out. They plotted, and Allah planned. And Allah is the best of planners."
That very night the Prophet ﷺ left for Madinah, and eight years later he returned to Makkah in victory, with almost no fighting. Did he give up in the dark years? No.
and that the whole universe is His.
following His commands where you are.
If everyone does his part, success is not far, and Allah will find a way.
It will take time to rebuild this Ummah. Start now.
